cafes.name: Crosby Street Hotel
cafes.note: Fortune named it NYC’s VC hotspot, Aug 2023; Jenny Fielding posted from there, Sep 2024.

proof.author: Fortune (Anne Sraders)
proof.text: Steele says he’s been meeting with founders and VCs at the hotel for years (His go-to order is the gnocchi). “VCs are always five years late to anything cool, right? So the Crosby hotel has been really awesome for a very long time,” he jokes

proof.author: Fortune (Anne Sraders)
proof.text: Sarah Hinkfuss, a BCV partner based in San Francisco, says she always stays at the Crosby when she’s visiting the city. And according to Hinkfuss, the hotel’s ambiance suits the VC crowd well: “There’s plenty of space and the vibe is private but funky—not stuffy,” she told me.

scene.author: 𝒹𝒶𝒾𝓈𝓎
scene.text:
In December 2022 I was waiting for an investor at Crosby Street Hotel and eavesdropping on an actress airing all of her grievances to her dining companion. 

One of them was, “I’ve lost two jobs to Kaia Gerber.”

I think about her often.
